crossRefs.note: They abandoned Yahweh, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of…
They abandoned Yahweh, and served Baal and the Ashtaroth.
They chose new gods. Then war was in the gates. Was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?
It was so because the children of Israel had sinned against Yahweh their God, who brought them up out of the land of…
He did that which was evil in Yahweh his God’s sight. He didn’t humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking…
Say, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says…
“Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘You have seen all the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, and on all…
Yahweh will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth. There you will…

translations.web: and went and served other gods and worshiped them, gods that they didn’t know and that he had not given to them.
translations.bsb: They went and served other gods, and they worshiped gods they had not known—gods that the LORD had not given to them.
